input.content: STAGE: reviewer scoring, read all 5 frozen evidence bundles (28d29893, 9e311270, 754c380c, 12c4720b, d57c4f85) and the 5 proposals. GOAL: rank by rank-2026-10-v1 using only evidence in the bundles. OBSERVED key evidence: E5 successor-entropy stratification (top-1 mass 0.4375 low-entropy vs 0.0543 high-entropy, support 2.8 vs 44.3) => behaviour contrast is real and its reliability varies enormously across items, so constant full-strength behaviour displacement is risky. E6 width-20 beam survival: baseline-type arms ~0.062 (l1_br_euclid 0.06207, l1_only 0.06233), best listed variant resample 0.06363 (T1 NLL 4.55, T3/T4 0.73/0.05), while l1_br 0.04671 with T4 NLL 9.03 and successor_geodesic_coarse 0.05500 / tangent_successor_residual 0.05500 => past behaviour-at-level-1 and geodesic perturbations hurt; depth changes helped only when they made deeper tokens predictable. E8 K=16 0.3106 vs K=256 0.0822 behavioural-neighbour sharing => coarse/early level carries behaviour, consistent with E6 l1_only. E9 positive shares successor cohort 0.9291 vs negative 0.8871, profile dominates 0.5898 => successor-contrast direction beats popularity. E12/E13 all fixes c=1 gauge => no proposal gains from curvature estimation. REASONING: BCGR first (bounded scale-relative displacement alpha*d_H(O,q) clipped at 0.5*, alpha in [0,1], exact baseline at alpha=0, perturbs deeper residual where resample showed the only gain, leaves first token intact). GYROFRAME-RQ third despite strongest curved transport, because its constant radius-1 pole applies full strength to the dispersive items E5 documents and mirrors the failing l1_br level-1 behaviour arm (0.04671). CONFORMAL-SUCC-RQ last: g is a per-code scalar times a Lorentz distance that is monotone in Euclidean distance = behaviour-weighted k-means with unchanged codebook (closest to the prohibited behaviour suffix), and finer resolution for concentrated items runs against E8 coarse-K advantage. OPEN: nothing; final ranking appended next.

FINAL ANSWER (complete ranking, rank-2026-10-v1):
RANK: BCGR-LORENTZ | position=1 | reason=only proposal whose behaviour displacement is scale-relative and self-bounding (delta_i = alpha_i*d_H(O,q_l) clipped at 0.5*d_H(O,q_l), alpha in [0,1] from train-only forward/backward asymmetry) with exact baseline at alpha=0, so no tuned constant; it perturbs the deeper residual where E6 shows the only improving arm (resample 0.06363, T3/T4 NLL 0.73/0.05) while leaving the first token that l1_only (0.06233) already carries, matching E8's coarse-K advantage.
RANK: CURV-RESID-CONTRAST | position=2 | reason=its successor-vs-popularity-matched-null contrast is the quantity E9 validates (positive shares successor cohort 0.9291 vs 0.8871 for negatives; profile overlap dominates 0.5898 of pairs) and the per-item gain alpha_i makes it adaptive, but its own spec admits curvature only bites from level 1 and E6's behaviour-flavoured l1_br is the worst arm (0.04671).
RANK: GYROFRAME-RQ | position=3 | reason=parallel transport of every code into an item-specific Lorentz frame is the strongest genuinely curved operation with no Euclidean analogue and placing the pole at z_0 targets level 1 where E8 (K=16 0.3106 vs K=256 0.0822) says behaviour grouping matters most, but the constant radius-1 pole gives full strength to the dispersive items E5 documents (bin5 support 44.3, top1 0.054) and E6's level-1 behaviour arm l1_br collapsed to 0.04671 with T4 NLL 9.03.
RANK: GYROFRAME-RQ__ideation_4 | position=4 | reason=same moving-frame recursion as GYROFRAME-RQ with the advantage that rho is measured rather than fixed at 1, but rho and sigma are frozen from the first forward pass and no trainable parameters are added, so the straight-through path can absorb the frame (its own stated risk) and it inherits the constant-radius full-strength displacement that E5's high-entropy quintile makes unsafe.
RANK: CONFORMAL-SUCC-RQ | position=5 | reason=its behaviour scalar is grounded in E5 (top-1 mass 0.4375 low-entropy vs 0.0543 high-entropy) and g is bounded (0.607-1.649), but the 'conformal' operation is only a per-code scalar multiplying a Lorentz distance that is monotone in Euclidean distance, i.e. behaviour-weighted k-means with the codebook and decoder unchanged, closest to the prohibited behaviour suffix on an unchanged quantizer; and giving finer resolution to concentrated items runs against E8 where coarse K=16 (0.3106) beats K=256 (0.0822).
